description: Publish now or schedule a post through an existing Social Fanout connection. Always call with dryRun=true first: it checks routing and entitlements without calling the social provider or using publish quota. Then publish live (dryRun omitted or false) only after the user approves the exact content, destination and schedule. Pinterest is immediate-only. Local stdio accepts an optional requestKey: retain the same key and unchanged live arguments across retries/reconnects; never replace it after uncertainty. Use distinct validation-only and approved-live keys. Without a key, legacy requests have no caller-key retry protection. This is not an exactly-once guarantee.

connectionId.description: Stored connection id when it differs from accountId.

dryRun.description: Send true first: checks routing and entitlements without calling a social provider or consuming publish quota. Omitted or false publishes live; use it only after the user approves the content, destination and schedule.

link.description: Optional Pinterest destination (click-through) URL: an absolute http(s) URL of at most 2048 characters. Other platforms ignore it, so put a URL in text for those.

mediaUrls.description: Public media URLs. Use [] for text-only posts.

pageId.description: Provider-specific target, such as a Pinterest board or Reddit target.

privacyLevel.description: Provider-specific privacy, such as public, unlisted, or private for YouTube.

requestKey.description: Local stdio only: stable identity for this exact command, sent only as Idempotency-Key. Use 1-200 non-space printable ASCII characters; strict-v1: is reserved. Generate once, keep the exact body and key after uncertainty, and check recent posts/job status before any retry. A genuinely new approved command needs a new key, even with identical content. Use a separate key for dryRun. Never use a JSON-RPC id or permanent content-only hash. Hosted MCP uses its confirmationToken instead.

scheduledAt.description: ISO datetime or null for immediate publishing.

subject.description: Optional title: the Pinterest Pin title (truncated to 100 characters) or the email subject. Other platforms ignore it.

name: fanout_publish_post
title: Publish or schedule post
